title: Long Trail Planner Printable, Thru Hike Planner, Section Hike Workbook, Resupply and Mileage Planner, Backpacking Gear List PDF
description:
Dreaming of a long trail? This 32-page fill-in workbook turns 'one day' into a plan with dates: a few sections of the Appalachian Trail, the Pacific Crest Trail, the Long Trail, the Colorado Trail or any multi-week route. Permits, transport, daily mileage, resupply, budget, food, water and gear weight all live in one place, and the daily log pages come with you.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- How to use the workbook: section hike vs thru-hike, with print tips
- Long trail dream page and an honest fit check: days off, fitness, budget, overnight experience
- Choose a trail: a comparison grid you fill in (length in mi and km, season, permits, daily miles, resupply style) with the official trail organizations to check
- Section planner to split a trail into weekends and vacations
- Timeline: 12 months, 6 months, 1 month and 1 week to-do lists
- Permits and registration tracker, transport and shuttle page
- Daily mileage planner with zero, nero and buffer days
- Resupply planner and a mail drop box packing list
- Budget, food and water planners
- Gear list with weights in oz and g, plus a base weight calculator
- Shakedown hike log and an 8-week training outline
- Safety plan: trip plan left with a contact, check-ins, turnaround rules, weather and wildfire sources
- Home logistics: bills, pets, mail, work
- Six weeks at a glance, 10 daily trail log pages, town day checklist and an after-the-trail review

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Color and printer-friendly (low ink) versions
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Permits, quotas, closures and resupply options change every year. Always check the trail's official organization and the land managers for your dates. Food pages give planning ranges, not diet advice. No maps or GPX files are included. Works for any trail. Not affiliated with any trail organization. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
sub: Permits, mileage, resupply, budget and gear weight for a section hike or thru-hike, in one workbook.
formats: Sized for reading on your phone
